title: 第1998章 域主要干你你这么好心第1997章 难为情的物品成功凝炼
slug: 系统伴我成长助我无敌永生
lines: 林羽轻瞥着狂喜的公主，淡漠道
“交易既然完成，我们之间从此不拖不欠，就此别过吧。”
额！
看着欲要离开的某人，雪天后从激动中恢复清醒。
“等一下，你……你是不是叫做林羽？”
嗯？
林羽原本要化虚的身影顿时打住
，微侧着头
“怎么？有事？”
雪天后傲娇道
“如果你真叫这个名字，那不是本公主有事，而是你……有事。”
林羽先是一怔。
紧接着。
想到这位公主之前去筹备资源时，应该知道些什么。
沉吟少许何，他蓦然回首
“是吗？你……是否听到了什么不成？”
“哼！你这家伙小气到连个名号都不愿意告诉本公主，不过，本公主大人大量，不与你计较。
这么跟你说吧，有人要对付你，看在你帮本公主这么大忙的份上，本公主也不希望你早夭。”
林羽冷冷一笑
“呵！对付本尊？本尊的敌人又何曾在乎多上一个半个。”
七公主双手抱肩
“哼！你以为本公主说的是之前对付你的那些小卡拉米吗？
这一次，要对你出手的人，可不简单，他……是青云星域的域主。”
嗯？
林羽眼眸微微一眯，星域之主想弄自己？
“七公主，不知你还听到了什么信息，还请不吝告知。”
“哼！没事时左一个雪天后，右一个雪天后的叫，现在终于知道叫我七公主啦！
不过，看在你能干事的份上，本公主就告诉你好了，我去找青云星域域主弄资源时，刚好听到他要准备对你下手，他看上你手中那件宝贝。”
嗯？
林羽垂眸看了看腰间的小铃铛，眉头微微皱起。
“七公主，这个青云域主目前是什么修为？”
content_en:
Lin Yu glanced at the ecstatic princess and said indifferently
"Now that the deal is completed, there will be no defaults or arrears between us, so let's let this go."
Uh!
Seeing someone about to leave, the Snow Queen recovered from her excitement.
"Wait a minute, you...are you called Lin Yu?"
Huh?
Lin Yu's figure that was about to turn into reality suddenly stopped.
, tilting his head slightly
"What? Is something wrong?"
The Queen of Snow said arrogantly
"If you really call her by this name, it's not that I, the princess, have something to do, but that you... have something to do."
Lin Yu was startled at first.
Immediately afterwards.
Thinking about what this princess should have known when she went to prepare resources before.
After pondering a little, he suddenly looked back
"Really? Did you...did you hear something wrong?"
"Hmph! You are so stingy that you don't even want to tell me your name. However, I have a lot of people and I won't care about you.
Let me tell you this, someone is going to deal with you, and since you have helped me so much, I don’t want you to die young. "
Lin Yu smiled coldly
"Ha! How can you deal with me? Why do my enemies care about one and a half more people?"
The Seventh Princess hugs her shoulders
"Hmph! Do you think this princess is talking about those little Karami who dealt with you before?
This time, the person who wants to attack you is not an easy person. He... is the Territory Lord of Qingyun Star Territory. "
Huh?
Lin Yu narrowed his eyes slightly, did the Lord of the Star Territory want to do something to him?
"Seventh Princess, I don't know what else you have heard. Please feel free to tell me."
"Hmph! When there's nothing wrong, there's a Snow Queen on the left and a Snow Queen on the right. Now you finally know how to call me Seventh Princess!
However, for the sake of your ability, I will tell you this. When I went to find the master of the Qingyun Star Territory to get resources, I happened to hear that he was about to attack you. He was interested in the treasure in your hand. "
Huh?
Lin Yu lowered his eyes and looked at the small bell on his waist, and frowned slightly.
"Seventh Princess, what is the current cultivation level of this Qingyun Territory Lord?"
